cues: Asexual reproduction is quick and keeps a good variety exactly as it is, even a seedless banana.
But with no variation, a single disease can wipe out the whole crop.
Sexual reproduction is slower, but it creates variation, the raw material of breeding and of evolution.
text: The trade off. Asexual reproduction is quick and keeps a good variety exactly as it is, even a seedless banana. But with no variation, a single disease can wipe out the whole crop. Sexual reproduction is slower, but it creates variation, the raw material of breeding and of evolution.
